B2.what: Every allowed secondary at least 5% (same-side changeup 2%)

B3.what: No exact call above 60%, except 3-0 fastball

B7.what: Inside share of fastballs >= 12%; inside >= 3% in half of non-3-ball situations

B8a.what: Down share with a runner on 1st within 2 pt of bases empty

B8b.what: Off-speed share with a runner on 3rd at least 60% of bases empty

B8c.what: A pitch that isn't landing gets 0% with a runner on 3rd

B9.what: RP2: after a foul straight back that exact call gets 0%

B10.what: Fallback picks a pitch that is landing, not the most confident

B12.what: CR1 bans the mashed spot; CR2 keeps a power hitter off the middle

B13.what: Low eye grade raises two-strike chase by 5 pt over eye 3

T1.what: Contact grade 5 vs 1 moves two-strike chase by 5 pt

T2.what: Crowding raises fastball inside share by 5 pt

T3.what: Power grade 5 vs 3 moves calls off the middle
